title: Extremely disappointed May 2021
text:
I’ve enjoyed receiving the past 3 GQ boxes. There’s been some fun items and definitely worth the price. One example is the really nice throw included with the Fall package. I’ve even appreciated the personal care items. There were things I wouldn’t normally buy myself but have enjoyed using.
The Spring 2021 box is another story. Other than the Raen sunglasses it’s a huge disappointment compared to past boxes. The key fob isn’t anything special, or the straw (have had one for 18 months), the Pake plastic zipper bags will never be used, and the Harry’s deodorant stick can be bought at WalMart and Target.
If I receive another box like this I’ll cancel the subscription!
label: negative
